verdict.rationale: Gemini in Gmail is documented as able to 'delete multiple emails or add labels' on request (gmail-docs-14). Filters automatically apply label and forward actions to every message that matches criteria (gmail-docs-15, gmail-docs-28), and search operators can scope sets of messages (gmail-docs-12), so bulk actions are possible but only through narrow, thinly documented paths. Missing for 10: documented batch API endpoints for programmatic bulk modify/delete, a broader range of bulk operations beyond delete and label, limits and scale details, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
